equation: u_t + (u dot grad)u + grad(p) - nu*laplacian(u) = f; div(u)=0

domain.boundary: smooth zero extension of velocity and pressure outside support
domain.initial_condition: optimized nonzero field at t=0.25; not the paper zero-rest initial condition

forcing.restriction: Only a,c may be fitted. No residual-dependent basis or pointwise free force. Freeze family before optimization.
forcing.regularity: C-infinity compact support in space and t in [0,1]; structural proof pending

nontriviality.enforcement: normalize initial velocity parameters, reject collapsed candidates

optimization.sampling: uniform Cartesian box and time, plus separate core/axis/boundary strata
optimization.candidate_parameter_bounds: CR002 design; freeze before running optimizer

validation.operator: independent Cartesian finite differences, calibrated on analytic fields
norms: volume-weighted L2 spatial norm at each time
validation.spectral_report: energy versus spatial frequency at fixed times; report resolution sensitivity; no paper Fourier coefficients assumed
validation.acceptance: All hard constraints and thresholds at finest level plus explained convergence; numerical samples are not uniform proofs
validation.failure_policy: retain failed results; changing thresholds requires a new experiment version
validation.time_derivatives: one-sided calibrated stencils at time endpoints; centered stencils only strictly within the declared window
validation.scaled_core_profile_metric: At core_probe, form v=(sqrt(tau)*u_r,tau^(0.5+h)*u_theta,tau^(0.5+h)*u_z); report max_t norm(v(t)-v(0.25))/norm(v(0.25)); reject zero reference norm.
